1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of __C2-C12 alkyl, C6-C18 aryl, and arylalkyl__, and wherein the compound is prepared by a method comprising __reacting a β-keto ester with sodium hydride or sodium metal in an aprotic solvent at a temperature below 0°C__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is __C2-C12-alkyl, C6-C18-aryl, or arylalkyl__, and wherein R2 is not ethyl.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is __propyl, butyl, pentyl, or higher alkyl groups up to C12__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of __lithium or sodium__, and wherein the compound is prepared by __direct metallation of a β-keto methyl ester using lithium or sodium metal in an aprotic solvent__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (IIb) in which Z is __sodium__, and wherein the compound exhibits __enhanced stability compared to the corresponding potassium enolate__.
